help.pageDesc: Need help? Contact the OFAI team or check our frequently asked questions.
help.heading: Help & Support
help.subtitle: We're here to help
help.supportDesc: Our support team is available to help you with any question.
help.faq1a: OFAI shows you the best deals and discounts from local businesses in your city. You can search, filter and save your favorite offers.
help.faq2q: How do I invite friends to OFAI?
help.faq2a: From the mobile app, go to Account → "Invite friends". You'll get a unique referral link you can send to your friends.
help.faq3q: How do I change my city?
help.faq3a: You can change your preferred city from the Preferences page, using the city selector.
help.faq4q: How do I follow a business?
help.faq4a: Press the heart button on a business page. You'll receive notifications when new offers appear.
help.faq5q: How do I leave a review?
help.faq5a: Go to a business page and scroll down to the reviews section. Press "Write a review" and fill out the form.
help.faq6q: How do I delete my account?
help.faq6a: Go to Settings and press "Delete account" in the "Danger zone" section. You'll need to confirm with your password. Deletion is permanent.
help.faq7q: I'm a business owner. How do I sign up?
help.faq7a: Visit the For Business page to learn how you can add your business to OFAI and attract new customers with deals and discounts.

pricing.subtitle: Boost your visibility and attract more customers with the right tools.
pricing.selectBusinessDesc: Which business do you want to manage the subscription for?
pricing.faq1a: Your business appears in visible positions on the homepage and in offer listings, ahead of non-promoted ones. Ideal for attracting more customers quickly.
pricing.faq2a: When a user searches for offers or businesses, your results appear higher in the list. The more visible you are, the more chances of conversion.
pricing.faq3a: You can download statistical data (views, clicks, conversions) into a CSV file that you can open in Excel or Google Sheets for your own analysis.
pricing.faq4a: See how your business positions against competitors in the same area and category: comparisons of views, reviews and activity.
pricing.faq5a: When you receive a review, the AI proposes 3 response variants (professional, friendly, empathetic) based on the customer's comment. You choose, edit and send — without writing from scratch.
pricing.faq6q: What does "assisted setup by team" mean?
pricing.faq6a: Our team helps you set up your business profile: we fill in the information, upload images and optimize the presentation for you.
pricing.faq7a: You can send push notifications directly to users who have saved your business to favorites, with the desired message and offer, anytime you want.
pricing.faq8q: What happens to my data on downgrade?
pricing.faq8a: Your data remains safe. We never delete existing content. Only new options will be limited according to the chosen plan.
pricing.faq9q: Can I change or cancel the plan anytime?
pricing.faq9a: Yes. On upgrade you pay the pro-rata difference. Downgrade applies immediately, and the next invoice will be at the new plan price. You can cancel anytime from Business Portal — you keep access until the end of the paid period.
pricing.faq10q: Can I pay yearly instead of monthly?
pricing.faq10a: Yes. From Business Portal, Subscription tab, there's a Monthly/Yearly toggle. With the yearly plan you save 17% compared to monthly payment. You can switch from monthly to yearly anytime.

privacy.pageDesc: OFAI Privacy Policy — how we collect, use and protect your data.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1p1: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information.
privacy.s2li1: Identification data: name, surname, email address
privacy.s2li3: Preferences: preferred city, categories of interest
privacy.s2li5: Location data: GPS coordinates (only with your permission)
privacy.s2li6: Technical data: device type, operating system, app version
privacy.s2li7: Usage data: pages visited, features used
privacy.s2li10: Sensitive data (ethnic origin, religious beliefs, health data)

privacy.s5highlight: We do not sell, rent or share personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.s5intro: We may share data only with:

privacy.s8li1: Right of access to personal data
privacy.s8p1: You can file a complaint with the National Supervisory Authority (ANSPDCP): www.dataprotection.ro
privacy.s9p1: On the web platform we only use essential cookies for site operation (authentication) and preference cookies. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy.s10p1: We will respond within 30 days of receiving your request.
privacy.gdprNote: This privacy policy complies with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Romanian legislation in force.
